activity_context.topic_title: Solving 3x3 Singular Systems of Equations Using Gaussian Elimination

feedback.problem:
Consider the system

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}-2{x}_{3}=-2 \\ -2{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}+5{x}_{3}=3 \\ 5{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2}-11{x}_{3}=-10.\end{aligned}
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form.
feedback.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & -2 & -2 \\ -2 & -1 & 5 & 3 \\ 5 & 4 & -11 & -10\end{aligned}].
$$

Reducing $M$ to echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & -2 & -2 \\ -2 & -1 & 5 & 3 \\ 5 & 4 & -11 & -10\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & -2 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & -1 \\ 5 & 4 & -11 & -10\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-5){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & -2 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & -1 \\ 0 & -1 & -1 & 0\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & -2 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
